v1.2.3.name: Bloodborne PC Vulkan v1.2.3
v1.2.3.body:
## Bloodborne PC Vulkan v1.2.3 (Windows & Linux)

**Quick Start:** Extract next to your `CUSA03173` (`v1.09`) folder and run **`Bloodborne.exe`** / **`Launcher.exe`** (Windows) or **`./play.sh`** / **`./launcher.sh`** (Linux).

### What's New
- **Fixed Slow-Motion When Running Below FPS Cap / VSync (Issue #1)** — Fixed a frame-pacer bug where gameplay could run in slow-motion whenever actual FPS stayed below your configured FPS cap (or monitor refresh rate under VSync).
- **Cleaner AA & Proper Post-FX Order (Lower Load & ~130 MB Less VRAM)** — Moved temporal anti-aliasing and upscaling (`DLAA / DLSS / FSR / TAA`) ahead of post-processing in true HDR space. Thin geometry, hair, and foliage look sharper with less shimmer, while Bloom, Motion Blur, Depth of Field, Chromatic Aberration, and Fire Heat Haze stay crisp — saving ~130 MB of VRAM and cutting GPU load.
- **All Post-Processing & Screen Effects Native in Vulkan** — Rewrote ambient occlusion into native Vulkan shaders, consolidated glossy reflections and post-effects (Motion Blur, Bloom, Auto-Exposure, Chromatic Aberration) into faster native passes, and removed leftover unused work.
- **Lower GPU Load, Heat & Higher Smoothness** — Optimized shadows, lighting blur, final color output, and heavy world/foliage shaders across Yharnam, Iosefka's Clinic, and Hunter's Dream, noticeably lowering GPU power draw and boosting high-FPS smoothness.
- **Expanded Shader Pre-Bake Catalog (+1,095 New Recipes)** — Added 819 new graphics pipelines and 263 shader variants to the built-in shader catalog so fresh installs pre-compile even more of the game upfront with fewer in-game stutters.
- **Cleaner, Privacy-Safe Diagnostic Logs** — Removed repetitive startup log spam (~3.5× smaller logs), scrubbed user home folder paths from logs, and added a compact Windows/Linux hardware summary (OS, CPU, RAM, live usage, and automatic hitch alerts) to make troubleshooting crashes and stutters effortless.

v1.2.2.name: Bloodborne PC Vulkan v1.2.2
v1.2.2.body:
## Bloodborne PC Vulkan v1.2.2 (Windows & Linux)

**Quick Start:** Extract next to your `CUSA03173` (`v1.09`) folder and run **`Bloodborne.exe`** / **`Launcher.exe`** (Windows) or **`./play.sh`** / **`./launcher.sh`** (Linux).

### What's New
- **New Native Vulkan Post-Processing** — Replaced the old PS4 post-processing pipeline with a much faster native Vulkan version (Tonemap, Bloom, Depth of Field, Motion Blur) that keeps 1:1 original Bloodborne colors while running nearly twice as fast.
- **Native HDR10 Output** — Added true 10-bit HDR10 support with live SDR/HDR switching right in `System -> Effects` on compatible monitors.
- **Upgraded Shadows, Indirect Lighting & Heat Haze** — Added contact-hardening soft shadows (`PCSS`), smoother indirect bounce lighting (`SSGI`), FPS-normalized Motion Blur (so blur looks right at 60–170+ FPS), and subtle **Fire Heat Haze** above torches and bonfires.
- **Glass-Smooth Frame Pacing** — Eliminated micro-jitter spikes for noticeably smoother camera motion at high FPS.
- **Fixed Inverted Camera Y-Axis (Issue #3)** — Fixed a bug where toggling vertical camera inversion also inverted horizontal look.
- **Built-In GPU Bottleneck Profiler** — Added a one-click profiler in the `Insert` debug menu to help pinpoint heavy scenes and shaders.

### What's Fixed
- **Fixed Linux Startup Crash on Non-AVX-512 CPUs (Issue #3)** — Rebuilt the Linux release cleanly for standard `x86-64-v3` CPUs so it runs out of the box on AMD Ryzen 1000–5000 (including 5700X3D/5800X3D), Intel 4th–14th gen / Core Ultra, and Steam Deck.
- **Fixed Linux Auto-Resolution & Self-Contained Libraries** — Fixed `GPU unknown` detection so 1440p/4K/ultrawide Linux monitors run at true native resolution out of the box, and bundled required shared libraries for better compatibility across distros.

v1.2.0.name: Bloodborne PC Vulkan v1.2.0
v1.2.0.body:
## Bloodborne PC Vulkan v1.2.0 (Windows & Linux)

**Quick Start:** Extract next to your `CUSA03173` (`v1.09`) folder and run **`Bloodborne.exe`** / **`Launcher.exe`** (Windows) or **`./play.sh`** / **`./launcher.sh`** (Linux).

### What's New
- **Massive CPU & High-FPS Boost (+35–55% Faster in Heavy Areas)** — Overhauled every major CPU bottleneck across the entire rendering pipeline: the DirectVk RHI stage, Vulkan command recording, pipeline lookup, light/VFX batchers, `141` native Vulkan shaders, and Bloodborne's multi-threaded scene worker pool. Central Yharnam now runs **330–375+ FPS** at native `1440p` (and **450–500+ FPS** in lighter views) on high-end hardware, pushing even an RTX 4090 into GPU-bound territory.
- **1-Second Death Respawn & Fast-Boot (~1 s Faster Startup)** — Fixed death/warp loading screens getting trapped behind Bloodborne's hidden 12-second item-tips timer and early burst timeout: respawning now finishes in **~1.3 seconds** (down from `12.6 s`!). Want to read item descriptions on loading screens? Toggle **`Loading Screen Tips Timer`** live anytime in `System -> Controls`. Also moved DLSS & PSO prewarm into background threads, cutting almost a full second off startup to the main menu.
- **57× Faster Linux Shader Pre-Bake (~4 Seconds for All 5,761 Shaders)** — Fixed a Linux-only allocator bottleneck (`M_ARENA_MAX=1`) that serialized all 24 pre-bake threads behind a single heap lock, slashing full clean Pre-Bake time from **~3.5 minutes down to ~4 seconds** (and fixed startup hangs when disabling native shaders in diagnostics).
- **Fixed 90+ FPS Character Twitching on Curbs & Uneven Ground** — Fixed unscaled per-frame slope-slide physics (`>35°` beveled curbs/tomb borders), foot-IK pelvis height smoothing, and sprint wall-recovery so walking over curbs and small bumps stays completely smooth at 90, 120, 170+ FPS.
- **True High-FPS Cloth & Cape Physics (Stiffness + Shoulder Friction)** — Upgraded Havok Cloth stiffness scaling to Havok's native substep exponent (`frames^1.725`) and added dt-adapted collision friction across all 17 body/landscape collider paths so capes, mantles, and belts drape naturally instead of stiffening or sticking to shoulders at 90–300+ FPS.
- **Fixed Disappearing / Flickering Blood Decals on Cobblestones** — Disabled G-Buffer draw reordering by default and hardened occlusion culling filters so ground blood pools never blink or disappear under shallow camera angles while keeping full wall occlusion culling.
- **Faster Multi-Core Scene Workers & Lower CPU Heat** — Replaced legacy kernel semaphore wakeups on Bloodborne's 6 graphics worker threads with a lock-free user-space wakeup coordinator, balanced work distribution across all workers, and inlined the hot C++20 shader/vertex binding loops.
- **Fixed Missing Faces in `Load Game` & Character Creation** — Restored `Relaxed` GPU readbacks by default (`0%` FPS impact) so `FaceGen` character faces render properly everywhere.
- **Crisp UI & Clean Defaults Out of the Box** — Enabled **`UI & Icons Upscale`** (`xBRZ + SDF 2x–4x`, `0 ms` runtime cost) by default, hid `F8` / `F9` debug overlays by default (still one keypress away), and moved the launcher update indicator into a sleek animated sidebar icon above the audio controls.
- **Upgraded `F9` Performance X-Ray Overlay** — Added a live 5-line breakdown of Bloodborne's main game-engine CPU thread alongside `Stage A`, `Stage B`, and GPU passes so you can instantly see what drives your frame time.

v1.1.9.name: Bloodborne PC Vulkan v1.1.9
v1.1.9.body:
## Bloodborne PC Vulkan v1.1.9 (Windows & Linux)

**Quick Start:** Extract next to your `CUSA03173` (`v1.09`) folder and run **`Bloodborne.exe`** / **`Launcher.exe`** (Windows) or **`./play.sh`** / **`./launcher.sh`** (Linux).

### What's New
- **Authentic Native Launcher Overhaul** — Redesigned the launcher with a clean dark-slate glass look and zero startup flicker. Instead of shipping any copyrighted assets, it decodes the official Bloodborne title artwork, Victorian game font (with full Cyrillic support), and ambient music (*Hunter's Dream* & *Omen*) straight from your own game files on first run — so the launcher feels like an official native companion app.
- **Seamless Game Boot Splash** — Launching the game now opens straight into Bloodborne's authentic title artwork and hands off cleanly to the main menu with no black-screen flash.
- **Fixed Cathedral Ward & Oedon Chapel Crash** — Fixed a reproducible multi-thread crash that happened when entering Cathedral Ward / boss areas.
- **Fixed Pink/Blue Window Glow** — Corrected an RGB/BGR color inversion bug on glowing gothic windows and bloom passes so Yharnam's sunset light stays warm amber as intended.
- **Fixed Crash When Toggling Graphics Effects Live** — Switching Bloom, DoF, SSAO, or SSR on/off in-game no longer risks crashing.
- **Live In-Game VSync (`Fast / On / Off`)** — Switch VSync modes on the fly in `System -> Display` without restarting.
- **Faster Game Startup** — Skips redundant binary prep on repeat launches, cutting ~2.3 seconds off every boot.
- **Better Crash Reports & 1-Click Auto-Updater Fix** — Crash logs (`logs/crash-*.log`) are never left empty on multi-thread crashes, and the built-in 1-click updater works reliably again.

### What's New
- **Complete Full-Game Shader Pre-Bake (`5,761` Shaders)** — Expanded the pre-baker to cover every shader archive plus all shaders embedded inside `eboot.bin`. Pre-bake once in the launcher (or let the quiet background auto-baker finish while you play) so you don't get shader-compile stutters during gameplay.
- **Zero-Pop-In Async Shader Compilation** — Eliminated multi-second stalls and invisible armor/character pop-in on first combat hits when a rare shader variant compiles on the fly.
- **Fixed Missing Blood Splatter on Hunter's Clothes & Face** — Restored dynamic blood splatter on your attire, cape, and face after combat kills on modern desktop GPUs.
- **Free Extra FPS & Stability** — Added front-to-back G-Buffer sorting, faster resource resolution, more native Vulkan shaders (`129` total), a Windows cold-start fix, and an automatic frame-spike log (`logs/bb_hitch.log`).

v1.1.5.name: Bloodborne PC Vulkan v1.1.5
v1.1.5.body:
## Bloodborne PC Vulkan v1.1.5 (Windows & Linux)

**Quick Start:** Extract next to your `CUSA03173` (`v1.09`) folder and run **`Bloodborne.exe`** / **`Launcher.exe`** (Windows) or **`./play.sh`** / **`./launcher.sh`** (Linux).

### What's New
- **Shader Pre-Baker & Quiet Background Auto-Baker** — Pre-compiles game shaders ahead of time (with a `0% -> 100%` progress bar in the launcher) to eliminate gameplay stutters.
- **Silky-Smooth Frame Pacing & `1000+ Hz` Mouse Input** — Overhauled frame pacing and switched mouse input to event-driven polling. Moving the camera while playing feels noticeably smoother with almost zero frame-time jitter.
- **New `Balanced` Smooth Camera (`F4` Live Switch)** — Inspired by *Lies of P*'s smooth camera feel, refined specifically for Bloodborne so strafing, sprinting, and climbing stairs feel fluid without harsh camera jerks. Switch live anytime between `Original (PS4)`, `Balanced`, and `Locked (1:1)`.
- **4–5× Faster Location & Respawn Loading** — Accelerated decompression and loading-screen pacing so warping and respawning take ~2–3 seconds instead of 11–12.
- **Expanded In-Game Menus & Scrollbars** — Redesigned the in-game `System` menu with comfortable gothic scrollbars, instant mouse-wheel scrolling, `Exit Game` right on the Title Screen, and instant saving of all settings.
- **1-Click Auto-Updater & Crash Black-Box** — Update directly from the launcher with SHA-256 verification, and get automatic crash reports (`logs/crash-*.log`) if anything ever goes wrong.

v1.0.0.name: Bloodborne PC Vulkan v1.0.0
v1.0.0.body:
## Bloodborne PC Vulkan v1.0.0 (Linux Initial Prebuilt Release)

**Quick Start:** Extract next to your `CUSA03173` (`v1.09`) folder and run **`./play.sh`** (or **`./launcher.sh`**).

### Highlights
- **Refactored Native C++20 Graphics Engine** — Replaced the heavy PS4 rendering bottleneck with native C++20 and Vulkan 1.3 split VRAM, drastically cutting RAM/VRAM usage and unlocking true uncapped FPS.
- **Full In-Game PC Menu & Controls Refactor** — Rebind any keyboard & mouse control (including mouse wheel and alternate keys) and change graphics, resolution, upscalers, and effects live right inside Bloodborne's own `System` menu — no external launcher restart required.
- **Modern Upscalers & Optional Remaster Visuals** — Live support for `DLSS 4.5` / `DLSS 4` / `DLAA` / `FSR 3.1 & 4`, `2×/4×` GPU UI & icon upscaling, fixed dark foliage undersides, and 4 optional remaster toggles (`GTAO/SSAO`, `Contact Shadows`, `Adaptive SSR`, and `True Black / OLED`).
